assets.title: Cosmic Cliffs of Carina
assets.explanation: Webb's infrared view of the star-forming edge of NGC 3324 in the Carina Nebula.

assets.title: Pillars of Creation
assets.explanation: Hubble's high-resolution visible-light portrait of the Pillars of Creation in the Eagle Nebula.

assets.title: Hubble Ultra Deep Field
assets.explanation: Thousands of galaxies fill one of Hubble's deepest views of the universe.

assets.title: A Little Red Dot
assets.explanation: Webb looks across cosmic time toward Abell 2744 and very distant early-universe objects.

assets.title: Tarantula Nebula
assets.explanation: Webb's near-infrared view of star-forming region 30 Doradus.

assets.title: Rho Ophiuchi Cloud Complex
assets.explanation: Webb's multicolored view of a nearby star-forming region with dust and nebulosity.

assets.title: Orion Nebula
assets.explanation: Hubble's expansive mosaic of the Orion Nebula reveals stellar nursery details.

assets.title: Whirlpool Galaxy
assets.explanation: Hubble's stunning face-on spiral galaxy with sharp dust lanes and golden star-forming regions.

assets.title: Blue Star in a Dark Nebula
assets.explanation: A brilliant blue-white star HD 97300 ignites a glowing reflection nebula against dense dark clouds in the Chamaeleon star-forming region.

assets.title: IC 4592 — The Blue Horsehead Nebula
assets.explanation: The hot blue star Nu Scorpii paints a vast reflection nebula in the constellation Scorpius, surrounding the ghostly Blue Horsehead cloud at 9.8K resolution.

assets.title: Rho Ophiuchi Star-Forming Tendrils
assets.explanation: A dramatic wide-field view of the Rho Ophiuchi molecular cloud — one of the nearest stellar nurseries — with orange dust filaments and blue reflection nebulae.

assets.title: The Lagoon Nebula in Infrared
assets.explanation: VISTA's 17K infrared panorama of the Lagoon Nebula NGC 6523 strips away the dust to reveal thousands of young stars embedded in glowing pink gas.

assets.title: Seagull Nebula over the Southern Milky Way
assets.explanation: A sweeping 20K mosaic of the Seagull Nebula IC 2177 in Monoceros, with wings of ionised hydrogen blazing pink and orange across a star-rich Milky Way field.

assets.title: Star Cluster NGC 1850 in the LMC
assets.explanation: A young double star cluster blazes at the heart of the Large Magellanic Cloud, surrounded by wisps of nebulosity and older surrounding stars.

assets.title: Rho Ophiuchi — Webb's Star-Birth Portrait
assets.credit: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI, K. Pontoppidan (STScI)
assets.explanation: Webb's first-anniversary image: the nearest stellar nursery in exquisite 12K infrared detail, with jets of pink hydrogen slicing dark filaments and young sun-like stars.

assets.title: Heart of the Tarantula — 30 Doradus
assets.explanation: A multiwavelength composite of the Tarantula Nebula 30 Doradus, blending optical and infrared data to reveal the most luminous star-forming region in the Local Group.

assets.title: Moonlit Pacific from the ISS
assets.explanation: Moon glint, airglow and stars photographed from the International Space Station above the Pacific Ocean.

assets.title: Aurora from the Station
assets.explanation: Earth's limb and aurora beneath the International Space Station's solar arrays.

assets.title: Orbital Star Trails
assets.explanation: A long-duration exposure from the ISS turns city lights and stars into streaks above Earth.

assets.title: Earthset from Orion
assets.explanation: Earth drops behind the Moon as photographed from the Orion spacecraft.

assets.title: Blue Marble 2012
assets.explanation: A detailed full-disk composite of Earth showing oceans, continents, and atmosphere.

assets.title: Black Marble
assets.explanation: A global night-time composite showing city lights, auroras, and natural luminescence.

assets.title: Artemis Era Earthrise
assets.explanation: A crescent Earth framed through the window of the Orion spacecraft.

assets.title: Aurora and City Lights
assets.explanation: Aurora borealis and night-side city lights illuminate Earth from the ISS vantage point.

assets.title: Jupiter's Great Red Spot
assets.explanation: Voyager 1's high-resolution color view of Jupiter and the Great Red Spot.

assets.title: The Rich Colors of Pluto
assets.explanation: New Horizons' enhanced-color portrait of Pluto from its 2015 flyby.

assets.title: The Day the Earth Smiled
assets.explanation: A 9,000-pixel Cassini mosaic of Saturn backlit by the Sun, with Earth as a faint dot.

assets.title: Saturn Noodle Mosaic
assets.explanation: Cassini's Grand Finale mosaic reveals Saturn's north polar vortex, hexagon and cloud bands.

assets.title: 95 Minutes Over Jupiter
assets.explanation: A dramatic 16K-wide JunoCam sequence captures Jupiter's cloud patterns and colors.

assets.title: Juno Captures Brown Barge
assets.explanation: A 6K Juno observation of a prominent brown feature in Jupiter's atmosphere.

assets.title: Turbulence in Jupiter's Atmosphere
assets.explanation: A recent 6.8K Juno image of dramatic cloud formations in Jupiter's upper atmosphere.

assets.title: Pluto's Twilight Zone
assets.explanation: New Horizons captures Pluto's crescent with atmospheric haze and subtle color contrasts.

assets.title: CubeSats Deploy from the ISS
assets.explanation: A trio of CubeSats deploys into Earth orbit from the International Space Station.

assets.title: Orion Approaches the Moon
assets.explanation: The Orion spacecraft approaches the Moon during Artemis I's outbound powered flyby.

assets.title: Orion Between Earth and Moon
assets.explanation: Orion's solar array wing cuts between Earth and Moon during Artemis I.

assets.title: Orion Looks Back
assets.explanation: The Orion spacecraft looks back at the Moon late in the Artemis I mission.

assets.title: Dragon CRS-9 Approaches the ISS
assets.explanation: The SpaceX Dragon cargo spacecraft approaches the International Space Station for docking.

assets.title: Moonlit ISS Solar Arrays
assets.explanation: ISS hardware glows with an unusual violet hue under moonlight in Earth orbit.

assets.title: Voyager Enters Interstellar Space
assets.explanation: An 8K NASA/JPL concept depicting the historic Voyager probe leaving our solar system.

assets.title: Perseverance Rover on Mars
assets.explanation: A photorealistic concept rendering of the Mars 2020 Perseverance rover at work on the Martian surface.

assets.title: Gargantua and the Endurance
assets.explanation: A high-resolution Interstellar-inspired view of the Endurance crossing Gargantua's accretion disk.

assets.title: Endurance Near Gargantua
assets.explanation: A 4K Interstellar frame-style composition with the Endurance silhouetted against Gargantua's bright disk.

assets.title: Gargantua Event Horizon
assets.explanation: A cinematic close view of Gargantua's warped light and accretion disk.

assets.title: Wormhole Approach
assets.explanation: A 4K wormhole view with distorted starlight and no foreground characters.

assets.title: Endurance Above a Storm World
assets.explanation: A wide, high-resolution spacecraft shot with the Endurance suspended over a turbulent alien world.

assets.title: Gargantua Singularity
assets.explanation: A stark black-hole composition centered on Gargantua's luminous ring.

assets.title: Black Hole Satellite View
assets.explanation: A 5K deep-space spacecraft scene looking toward a black hole and its surrounding disk.

assets.title: Gargantua Blue Lens
assets.explanation: A 5K black-hole render with blue-white lensing and a clean wallpaper silhouette.

assets.title: Gargantua Close Pass
assets.explanation: A clean 4K black-hole pass with a bright accretion disk and a small spacecraft silhouette.

assets.title: Gargantua Minimal Ring
assets.explanation: A stark 4K Gargantua-style black-hole ring against a deep black star field.

assets.title: First Photograph of a Black Hole
assets.explanation: Humanity's first direct image of a black hole: the 6.5-billion-solar-mass giant at the centre of galaxy M87, captured at 7.4K resolution by the Event Horizon Telescope.

assets.title: Dust Rings of Proxima Centauri
assets.explanation: An 8K artist's impression of the debris disk surrounding Proxima Centauri — our nearest stellar neighbour — a vast dust ring that may hide further undiscovered worlds.

assets.title: The Closest Black Hole to Earth
assets.explanation: Artist's impression of HR 6819 — a triple system just 1,000 light-years away harbouring a dormant black hole, with the orbital paths of its two companion stars traced in colour.

assets.title: A Dormant Black Hole Unmasked
assets.explanation: An artist's view of the first dormant stellar black hole confirmed outside the Milky Way — a dark void orbiting tight against a blazing blue giant in the Large Magellanic Cloud.

assets.title: Ultra-Hot Jupiter on a Close Orbit
assets.explanation: An artist's impression of an ultra-hot Jupiter exoplanet locked in a scorching close orbit — temperatures above 3,000 K strip the planet's atmosphere away into space.

assets.title: Super-Earths of Gliese 667C
assets.explanation: A barren rocky super-Earth looms in the foreground while a smaller ocean world hangs in the distance — both orbiting the red dwarf Gliese 667C in this cinematic artist's impression.

assets.title: Proxima b Surface
assets.explanation: An artist's impression of the rocky exoplanet Proxima b orbiting the nearest star to the Sun.

assets.title: Lava World 55 Cancri e
assets.explanation: A 10K artist's concept of the super-Earth 55 Cancri e, a hot rocky planet with a partially molten surface.

assets.title: WASP-121 b
assets.explanation: A hot Jupiter artist impression showing the strongly irradiated exoplanet WASP-121 b near its host star.

assets.title: K2-18 b
assets.explanation: A distant view of exoplanet K2-18 b and its red-dwarf host star in an artist's concept.

assets.title: GJ 1132 b
assets.explanation: A rocky exoplanet artist impression set against the Milky Way and its host star.

assets.title: Neutron Star Merger
assets.explanation: An artist's impression of two merging neutron stars producing a bright kilonova.

assets.title: M87 Black Hole Concept
assets.explanation: An artist's impression of the supermassive black hole at the center of Messier 87 and its hot accretion flow.

assets.title: HD 131399Ab
assets.explanation: A triple-star exoplanet artist impression with three suns visible from a distant giant world.

assets.title: Isolated Stellar-Mass Black Hole
assets.credit: ESA/Hubble, Digitized Sky Survey, Nick Risinger, N. Bartmann
assets.explanation: A Milky Way star field distorted by an isolated stellar-mass black hole in this artist's impression.

assets.title: Surface of TRAPPIST-1f
assets.explanation: An exoplanet surface concept with icy terrain, orange twilight, and neighboring TRAPPIST-1 worlds in the sky.

assets.title: Kilonova — Two Neutron Stars Collide
assets.explanation: An artist's impression of gravitational-wave event GW170817 — two neutron stars spiralling to a cataclysmic merger, forging gold and heavy elements in a brilliant blue-white kilonova flash.

assets.title: Black Hole in a Triple Star System
assets.explanation: An artist's impression of HR 6819: a dormant black hole caught silently orbiting within a triple star system — the closest known black hole to Earth.

assets.title: Ultra-Hot Jupiter on a Close Orbit
assets.explanation: A photorealistic artist impression of a gas giant on an extreme close orbit, its atmosphere blazing at over 3,000 K and being slowly stripped away by the host star's radiation.

assets.title: Super-Earths of Gliese 667C
assets.explanation: An artist's impression of the Gliese 667C planetary system: a barren rocky super-Earth in the foreground, a habitable ocean world in the distance, under the glow of a red dwarf sun.
